port.description: The TCP port number on which the Tang server listens. Corresponds to the -p flag.

endpoint.description: The URL endpoint prefix for the Tang service. Empty string means root path. Corresponds to the -e flag.

key_dir.description: The absolute path to the directory containing the JWK key files. Corresponds to the -k flag or default location.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging output. Corresponds to the -v flag.
